title: The Elf Who Lost Santa's List
tagline: A North Pole wind scattered Santa's list. Find every page before Christmas Eve!

checklist: Print and cut the list pages
Hide pages #2 through #10 using the hiding spot guide
Put the List Complete card under the Christmas tree (add a small treat or gift if you like)
Keep page #1 in your hand to start

intro.speaker: elf
lines: Oh, thank goodness you're here! I'm Juniper, and I keep Santa's list.
I was carrying it to the workshop when a big gust of North Pole wind blew the pages right out of my hands... and all over this house!
Santa needs the whole list by Christmas Eve. {name}, will you help me and Pip find every page?
Here's the first one. Let's go!

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Oh no, the pages flew away! One landed somewhere frosty and bright, where the milk stays cold all day and night!
steps.hint: Brrr! Try the fridge.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: One page floated way up high. Look where Santa leaves treats overnight, in fuzzy socks with names written bright!
steps.hint: Where do your Christmas stockings hang?
steps.spot: Stockings or fireplace (or a window ledge)

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Even elves wash up each day. Turn on the water, make bubbles play!
steps.hint: Where do you wash your hands?

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: Snuggle time is almost here! Where does your family sit and cheer? Dig in the cushions, soft and deep. A page crawled in there for a peek!
steps.hint: Peek between the couch cushions.

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Santa loves a story too. Look where the stories stand in a row, with pictures and pages ready to go!
steps.hint: Check the bookshelf.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: Sugarplums dance in sleepy heads. Look where you snuggle and say goodnight, under the blankets, tucked in tight!
steps.hint: Check a bed or under a pillow.

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Snowy feet come through the door. What do you kick off and leave on the floor? They come in pairs, a left and a right!
steps.hint: Look where the shoes and boots are kept.
steps.spot: Shoes or boots by the door

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: Elves build gifts for kids to play. Look where your teddies and blocks all stay!
steps.hint: Peek around the toys.

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Cookies for Santa, milk in a cup. You stir with one and scoop it up! Look in the kitchen where they stay, ready for dinner every day.
steps.hint: Check the spoon drawer in the kitchen.
steps.spot: Kitchen utensil drawer or cookie jar

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: One last page and then we're done! Look where the twinkly lights all glow, and presents wait in a pile below!
steps.hint: Where do the presents go?

found: Pip is doing a happy hop!

finale.artAlt: Juniper the Elf and Pip the Reindeer cheering with Santa's list
finale.title: Santa's List Is Saved!
lines: You found every single page! Santa's list is complete.
Thank you, {name}. You're officially a North Pole helper!

print.subtitle: A printable Christmas page hunt where kids find the pieces of Santa's list before Christmas Eve.
coverFeatures: Two clue sets: 10 for home, 10 for the classroom
Quest Master on your phone: reads the clues, gives hints, throws the confetti
Blank pages for your own hiding spots
print.storyTitle: A Letter from the North Pole
storyLines: It's Juniper, Santa's list-keeper elf. I have a teeny, tiny problem.
I was carrying Santa's list to the workshop when a gust of North Pole wind blew the pages right out of my mittens. They landed all over the place, and some landed right where you are!
Santa needs every page by Christmas Eve. Pip the reindeer and I can't do it without you.
Follow the clues. Each page you find leads to the next one.
Your first page is in your hands...

startCard.speaker: elf
startCard.title: Help! The List Is Lost!
startCard.text: A North Pole wind blew Santa's list away! Help me find every page before Christmas Eve!

whatToPrint: Home list-page clues (2 pages) or Classroom list-page clues (2 pages)
print.parentTip: Play it on Christmas Eve morning or the first day of winter break. Turn on the tree lights and some Christmas music before you start.

tips.title: Elf workshop craft station
tips.text: Let helpers make their North Pole gear while everyone gathers.
list: Paper elf hats with a bell or pom-pom
Paper chains to count down the pages
Reindeer antler headbands from brown paper strips

tips.title: Set the scene
list: Christmas music and tree lights only
Tape a "North Pole Mail" sign on the front door
Give the lead helper a title, like Head Elf

tips.title: North Pole snacks
tips.text: Save these for after the list is saved.
list: Reindeer food: snack mix with pretzels and chocolate candies
Candy cane quills for writing Santa a note

tips.title: Save Christmas
tips.text: When the last page turns up under the tree, read the whole list together. Then each helper writes one wish on a blank page to send to Santa.

certificate.title: Official North Pole Helper
certificate.body: for finding every missing page of Santa's list just in time for Christmas.
certificate.signer: Juniper the Elf & Pip the Reindeer

print.backLine: If your helpers loved this adventure, more holiday quests are on the way.

lines: Oh, thank goodness you're here! I'm Juniper, and I keep Santa's list.
I was carrying it to the workshop when a big gust of North Pole wind blew the pages right out of my hands... and all over this classroom!
Santa needs the whole list by Christmas Eve. {name}, will you help me and Pip find every page?
Here's the first one. Let's go!

checklist: Print and cut the classroom list pages
Hide pages #2 through #10 using the classroom hiding spot guide
Put the List Complete card by the classroom tree or holiday display (add treats if you like)
Keep page #1 in your hand to start

steps.riddle: Oh no, the pages flew away! Look where your backpacks wait all day, hanging on hooks until it's time to play!
steps.hint: Check the cubbies or backpack hooks.

steps.riddle: One page floated past a machine that goes grind, grind, grind! Where do dull pencils get sharp? Look and you will find!
steps.hint: Check by the pencil sharpener.

steps.riddle: Even elves need a drink each day. Find where the water splashes and sprays!
steps.hint: Check the classroom sink or water fountain.

steps.riddle: Criss-cross applesauce, sit down in a ring! Look on the spot where we gather to sing.
steps.hint: Check the rug where the class sits together.

steps.riddle: Santa loves a story too. Look where the stories stand in a row, with pictures and pages ready to go!
steps.hint: Check the class library or bookshelf.

steps.riddle: Crayons, glue sticks, scissors too! Look where the art things wait for you!
steps.hint: Check the art supply shelf or bins.

steps.riddle: Christmas Eve is coming near! Look where we count the days of the year!
steps.hint: Check the class calendar.

steps.riddle: Squeak, squeak, the markers go! Look where the teacher writes so we all know!
steps.hint: Check by the whiteboard.

steps.riddle: Who helps you read and learn and write? Check where they work, it's just in sight!
steps.hint: Check the teacher's desk.

steps.riddle: One last page and then we're done! Look where our holiday decorations shine for everyone!
steps.hint: Check the classroom tree or holiday decorations.
steps.spot: Classroom tree, holiday display or door
